findings.text: `ext/Chat/v2/readme.md` is now stale and unindexed on the new use: it says "Not wired yet" and only offers the standalone page, but ChatV2 is now mounted in the session page's Chat tab (`ai/AISession/AISessionDetail.js:257-274`). Add a line saying where it is embedded and that `?chat_view=v2` opens it (CLAUDE.md law 9/10).

The task folder holds no proof of the "Check" claim (557 items drawn at 400 and 1200, switching back hides v2): there are no screenshots or a note of the result beside requirements.md, only the diff, so a fresh agent cannot confirm it without redoing the run. Put the two shots (or the check output) in the folder.

`AISessionDetail.js:271`: if the page is deactivated while `record_if_there()` is still pending, `deactivated()` (line 119) calls `.then(c => c?.unsubscribe?.())` on the same promise, so it does clean up; but on a quick re-activation the pick re-runs `choose` and mounts a second ChatV2 on a new `$v2`, which is fine. No leak found; only noting the chain relies on that promise ordering.

Edits stay inside the Chat panel plus `deactivated()` and one import, as asked; v1 stays the default and the `chat_ok` rule is untouched. The v1 boxes (`$tasks`, `$box`, `$voice`, `$conv`) are only wrapped in `$v1`, so the later code that fills them is unchanged. Simple enough; no simpler route seen.

`choose` writes `?chat_view` with `history.replaceState` even on first build (line 273), harmless but it rewrites the URL on every page open; other tab-switching params in this file may use a shared helper worth reusing if one exists.

answer.reply: fixed: ext/Chat/v2/readme.md gets a 'Where it shows' line (the standalone page plus the session page's Chat v2 chip, ?tab=chat&chat_view=v2, with a live example). The 'Not wired yet' line about writers is left to the writers minion's 'Who writes' section, which replaces it in step 3.

fixed: shots/chatv2-tab-400.png, shots/chatv2-tab-1200.png and shots/probe.mjs (the headless run: 557 [data-id] in .chat-v2, the 'Chat' chip hides v2 and drops chat_view, 40 same 404s with v2 off/on) are now in this folder.
noted: deactivated() chains .then on the pending promise, so the ChatV2 made after it resolves is unsubscribed then; nothing leaks.
declined: replaceState with an unchanged URL is a no-op for the reader, and show() already rewrites the URL on build the same way; one code path is simpler than a guard.
